commons.title: Mount Bromo Horse 1.jpg
commons.description: The local Tenggerese tribe members operate the horse rides on Mount Bromo. The Tenggerese are a small Hindu minority living in the Muslim-dominated island of Java. About 90,000 Tengger people live in the villages surrounding Mount Bromo, and 500 horses inhabit the area around the volcano. The Tenggerese believe that the horses have a bond with the spirits that dwell in the volcano's crater. Initially, the horses were used for transport. But today, they are used for tourism, which is the commodity of the time.
commons.editorial_reason: Caption and category specifically identify Tenggerese horse operators; the image visibly shows a rider and the culturally attributed Mount Bromo horse-ride activity.

commons.title: Nyadran Karo.jpg
commons.description: Nyadran Karo adalah ziarah kubur masyarakat Tengger saat hari raya Karo. Hari raya Karo merupakan hari raya orang Tengger, hari raya lintas agama baik Hindu, Islam, dan Nasrani. Nyadran sebagai bentuk kebersamaan serta penghormatan kepada leluhur.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption specifically identifies a Tenggerese Nyadran Karo ancestral-visit ceremony, visibly showing ritual participants and ceremonial structures.
